videos.title: Folding Phones 7 Years Later... I was WRONG
videos.description:
Younger Karl was WRONG 
 
I dug back through the archives and found my first folding phone review from 2019… Clearly got that one wrong. 7 years later and comparing the OG Samsung Galaxy Fold to the latest Galaxy Z Fold8, there’s a huge difference and innovation in every single area. We now have the thinnest devices, better screens and different form factors to choose from. There has been no better time to upgrade to a @samsungcanada  Galaxy foldable!
